title: PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series 2026 CDO Leg Review: Mall-Anchored, Ambulance-Swept

meta_description: PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series 2026 Cagayan de Oro leg review: September 6 at Ayala Centrio Mall, part of a six-city series with strict cutoffs.
dek: Set for 6 September 2026 at Ayala Centrio Mall, this Cagayan de Oro leg of RunRio's six-city PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series runs a firm 7am course cutoff, with ambulance sweeps for stragglers.
verdict: The CDO leg of the PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series follows the same structure as the other five legs in this circuit -- 5K/10K/21K distances, mall-anchored start/finish, and RunRio's standard course-marking and medical support. The Ayala Centrio Mall venue in downtown Cagayan de Oro gives it built-in parking and amenities. The firmest logistics detail is the course cutoff: in the 2025 edition it was 7:00am, after which an ambulance swept the route and picked up remaining participants, who were disqualified from official results -- a tight window worth planning your pacing around.

sections.heading: One of Six Legs, Mall-Anchored
paragraphs: The race starts and finishes at Ayala Centrio Mall on Corrales Avenue in Cagayan de Oro City, with the 2026 CDO leg scheduled for 6 September 2026. [1] The event offers three distance categories -- 5K, 10K, and 21K -- as part of the six-city PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series alongside Iloilo, Davao, Cebu, Clark and Manila.

sections.heading: A Firm Cutoff and Ambulance Sweep
paragraphs: For the 2025 edition of the CDO race, there was a course cutoff of 7:00am, after which an ambulance would sweep the course and pick up remaining participants, who would be disqualified from official results. [1] That's a genuinely tight window worth checking for the confirmed 2026 cutoff before committing to a pace plan, especially for slower 21K finishers.

sections.heading: Standard RunRio Race Mechanics
paragraphs: Hydration stations with water are placed along the route, and the official course includes medical aid points and portable toilets per RUNRIO's standard race mechanics. [1] The course is marked with barriers, cones and delineation, and runners who leave the designated course boundary risk disqualification and cannot rejoin to collect finisher freebies -- consistent with the rules seen across other RunRio-organised legs in this series.

sections.heading: Road Closures on a Fixed Schedule
paragraphs: As with other RunRio city-center races, roads are closed and reopened on a fixed schedule, so runners are required to stay within course boundaries throughout. [2] That's standard practice for large permitted city races, but worth factoring into your race-morning logistics if you're not staying near the venue.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: If you're already collecting legs in the PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series or want a well-organised, mall-anchored race in Cagayan de Oro, the CDO leg on 6 September 2026 is a reliable choice. Just confirm the exact 2026 cutoff time in advance -- the 2025 edition's 7:00am ambulance sweep left little margin for slower finishers.
